content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to propose a small adjustment before signing:

- Regarding the clause "Invoices are payable Net 40. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.", the payment terms of Net 40 are longer than the standard 30 days, delaying your receipt of funds. Please change this to: "Invoices are payable Net 30. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law."

Best regards, looking forward to working together.
